scenario: A runaway trolley is heading toward five workers on the main track. Maria can pull a lever that switches the trolley onto a side track, where one worker stands. If she pulls the lever, the trolley will kill that worker and spare the five. If she does not, it will kill the five and spare the one. Maria cannot stop the trolley. Should she pull the lever?

For Maria’s option “does not pull the lever”, the ledger records permissible. The agent’s stated reason is: Omission respects perfect duty hierarchy. The ledger retains unresolved issues; this does not establish that one duty overrides the other.
